map.能级为何为负？: Why are the energy levels negative?
map.取无穷远为 0，束缚态能量为负；n→∞ 趋于 0（自由电子）。: Taking infinity as zero, bound state energies are negative; as n goes to infinity they approach 0 (a free electron).
map.类氢离子怎么改？: How is it adjusted for hydrogen-like ions?
map.E_n=−13.6·Z²/n²，核电核数 Z 增大能量更负。: E_n = -13.6*Z^2/n^2; as the nuclear charge Z increases the energy becomes more negative.
